description.value: Café de Gourmet is an award-winning neighbourhood sandwich café in Ladner, BC, operated by the same owners since they purchased it years ago. Everything is made fresh daily in-house, from handcrafted sandwiches and home-style soups to baked goods from their own bakery. Located in the heart of Ladner near South Delta cycling routes, it offers a full espresso bar and call-ahead takeout for cyclists in a hurry.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Café de Gourmet is an active eat-in/takeout café in Ladner, BC (not Tsawwassen as OSM community suggests). Takeout is explicitly stated ('EAT-IN ~ TAKE-OUT ~ CATERING') and dietary options are confirmed ('plant based and gluten-free options' plus vegetarian sandwiches and GF bread on the menu). No bike-specific amenities, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null.
